mutants.name: a documented knob is removed from the doc but kept in code (undocumented knob)
the stored local label regresses to the unversioned string
the false unconditional retry claim returns outside the quoted message
the doc stops saying where the primary's retry lives

problems: mutant [the false unconditional retry claim returns outside the quoted message] applied — mutation produced no change — fix the mutant
mutant [the false unconditional retry claim returns outside the quoted message] caught by the contract — survived
limitations: The knob contract is a NAME contract: it proves each documented BB_EMBEDDING_* var is loaded in src/, and that each one's BEHAVIOUR is what the doc says. Behaviour is asserted separately, not re-derived from the doc here.
Precedence over env vs config file is covered by script/m40/verify-a8-config.ts; this gate only proves the three var names are read in src/config/config.ts.
Doc mutants mutate the doc text in memory and re-run the real contract against it. EMBEDDINGS.md is never modified by this verifier.
Mutants are SKIPPED (not counted as failures) when the contract already fails, because a mutant applied to an already-broken document proves nothing about the mutant.
